Cloudflare's Code Mode introduces a different way for AI agents to interact with large API collections. Instead of exposing thousands of individual tool definitions, it provides a TypeScript interface that lets the model write code, chain API calls, and execute them inside a sandbox. In its 2,500-endpoint example, Cloudflare reports reducing tool-definition context from approximately 1.17 million tokens to around 1,000. Anthropic has also introduced Programmatic Tool Calling, while Block's Goose project explores code-based tool orchestration. In this video, I break down what this means for MCP and the future of AI agents. Cloudflare's original article: https://blog.cloudflare.com/code-mode-mcp/ Dm LINK for the breakdown and Claude Code Club access. #Cloudflare #MCP #ClaudeCode #AIAgents

Always-on personal agent harness: event inbox, timers, permissions and outbox, in real code. You are probably familiar with Muse, Grok Bot, OpenAI Dots and Claude Duet. Why is everyone building a personal agent? The short answer is they are always on. ChatGPT or Claude does not know you have a task coming up unless you type it into the chat box. An always-on agent wakes up when something happens. After reading Anthropic's newly published "Building always-on agents", I made a huge upgrade on Waku Agent, my open source agent harness, and I break down the system design in 18 minutes. Then I run it live in Slack. I tag it and it wakes up. It refuses to read my inbox in a shared channel. A timer I set fires one minute later. The router for team agents is still on the chart, not in the code yet. You Can Build Anything. You Can Learn Anything. 💪 #aiagents #claude #anthropic #agentharness #opensource

The full map is free. Link in bio. This is one company, drawn as a map. At the top: the tools it already runs on. Inbox, CRM, calendar, team chat, payments, books, files, calls. In the middle: Claude, reading all of it. Around it, seven departments. Sales (22 AI agents) builds the list, scores the fit and writes the first email. Deals (24) books the meeting, sends the proposal and keeps following up. Marketing (23) writes the hooks, the captions and the posts. Customer (14) triages tickets and spots accounts going quiet. Operations (19) handles kickoff, status updates and data moves. Back office (18) invoices, collects and tracks the budget. Intelligence (17) researches people and pricing before you walk in. Underneath sits one knowledge base they all read: SOPs, brand voice, price book, contracts. One job per agent. One written workflow per job. You approve anything that reaches a client, from your phone, and at 7 am you get a single page with what happened overnight. #aiagents #claude #automation #skilltree #aitools

People are wasting their time building AI agents. A model on its own needs context to be useful: prompts and instructions, tools it can call, and data it can trust. The old way was to write code that wires those three to the model, call it agent one, and do it again for every workflow. Harnesses like Claude Code and Codex already let an AI read and write your files, so you can put your prompts, tools and data in folders and let one AI become whatever agent your question needs. If you want something to study for the next ten years, I'd pick the Unix philosophy, Douglas Engelbart's 1962 report Augmenting Human Intellect, and plain old software logic. The long version, Do You Actually Need AI Agents?, is on my YouTube. Link in my bio. youtube.com/@creator_ad #ai #aiagents #claudecode

4 AI Agents To Automate 99% Of Your Life. Automate everyday workflows using AI agents without needing coding skills. The first pillar, Coordination, focuses on managing your Gmail inbox and Google Calendar to reclaim your daily focus. It teaches how to build agents that review unread emails, sort them into priority buckets, and draft intelligent responses. The second pillar, Creativity, turns rough notes into formatted pitch decks and professional documents using predefined skills. This allows you to rapidly build PowerPoint presentations while maintaining control over the direction and brand style. The third pillar, Clarity, helps analyze complex contracts, legal documents, and market research. It uses a microscope approach to break down dense text into plain-English risk assessments and structured summaries. The fourth pillar, Coaching, utilizes voice mode to simulate job interviews, negotiations, or high-stakes business meetings. By roleplaying with AI personas, you can practice your responses out loud and receive constructive feedback. #artificialintelligence #tecnologia #aiagents #automatic #Future #Productivity #airsoft #aidangallagher #ai
